name: OctoGlyphs
description: A private AI-work Tamagotchi sidecar that feeds from safe OpenClaw activity metadata without reading prompts, responses, code, files, diffs, or terminal output.

enabled.description: Emit safe activity metadata to OctoGlyphs.

gameUrl.description: Gateway-hosted OctoGlyphs route path. Advanced users may override for local development.

publicBaseUrl.description: Optional public Gateway base URL for clickable OctoGlyphs links, for example https://openclaw.example.com. Defaults to http://localhost:<gateway.port>.

emitModelEvents.description: Use sanitized model-call timing and token metadata when available.

emitToolEvents.description: Use sanitized tool category, duration, and success metadata.

debugSanitizedEvents.description: Log sanitized event shapes only. Never logs prompt, response, code, diff, file body, stdout, or stderr content.
